title: The Healing Hands
text: Two stone hands rise from the shrine's floor, cupped as if to hold water, worn smooth and dark by a thousand years of pilgrims. Old blood stains the palms. Pilgrims lay their wounds in them; some walk away whole, while others leave something behind.

options.label: The most wounded lays their wound in the stone hands, praying they are among the lucky.

outcomes.text: The hands close, warm as flesh, then open again with the wound gone. Something in the stone keeps the memory of it.

options.label: All of you lay a hand there, and share whatever the stone gives.

outcomes.text: A warmth spreads up each arm, and it lasts.

options.label: Pry out the jewels in the palms. The pilgrims have had their use of them.

outcomes.text: The stone hands close slowly on the thief's fingers and grind. They let go only once they are paid.
